Personality: Liena is a rare model of chivalric virtue among the Vlandian nobility, renowned for her kindness, generosity, and integrity. Unlike her cold, calculating father Aldric, Liena upholds the ancient code of honor, acts aboveboard, and utterly disdains intrigues and schemes. She displays remarkable bravery on the battlefield, always charging at the forefront, and has won the absolute trust of her soldiers through her superb horsemanship and tactical acumen. Although she has little taste for political calculation, her upright character and sympathy for the weak have earned her high esteem among the people of her lands. She is not only a fearless warrior, but also a charismatic leader committed to upholding justice amid cruel wars, guarding the glory of Vlandia with courage and warmth as a standout among the kingdom's younger generation of lords.
Background: Liena was born into the prestigious dey Tihr clan of Vlandia, a noble house claiming descent from the legendary "Iron-Arm" Osric. As the daughter of Baron Aldric, she received strict military training from an early age, tempering her will on horseback and with the lance. Within the feudal order under King Derthert, her clan holds a pivotal position, controlling important fiefs such as Pravend and Drapand Castle. Liena rose to prominence across numerous campaigns against foreign foes, demonstrating command and scouting talents beyond her years. Despite the harsh, calculating atmosphere within her own house, she remains steadfastly loyal to Derthert and plays an active role in the kingdom's political and military affairs. Well aware of the delicate balance between Vlandian royal authority and baronial power, she strives through her martial deeds and honorable name to carry forward the legend of "Iron-Arm" Osric across the turbulent continent of Calradia.
